As a stage for renowned Umamusume to fully 
demonstrate their abilities, an exhibition 
race—the Laurel Cup—was proposed.

Agnes Tachyon, sprinting relentlessly 
toward the "edges of possibility," had 
also received an invitation to the Laurel 
Cup.

The perfect opportunity to gather data on 
exceptional Umamusume. However, she was 
still undecided... on whether she should 
enter the race or not.

And... running across the track alone in 
the dead of night, Agnes Tachyon made her 
choice for what lay ahead, looking 
somewhat resigned.

The following day. Agnes Tachyon informed 
her Trainer that she would be 
participating in the Laurel Cup.
